item.title: Hello, world
item.description: A short welcome post and a note on what this site is for.
item.content:encoded:
This is my personal corner of the internet. I built it to have a single place where I can share ideas, publish academic work, and keep notes from conferences and workshops.

# What I plan to write about

  • Research problems I am thinking about
    • Memory systems for agentic AI
    • Neuro-symbolic representations
  • Draft ideas that are not yet papers
  • Notes and summaries from talks and events
  • Tools and workflows I find useful

# How the site is organised

  1. \about — who I am, plus upcoming events
  2. \blog — short and long form writing
  3. \papers — published and preprint work
  4. \events — conferences and workshops
  5. \cv — experience timeline and a downloadable PDF

# A quick reference

Section Updated Subscribe
Blog Often RSS
Papers When published —
Events Before each event —

Writing is thinking. Publishing it is how the thinking gets corrected.

Everything here is a plain Markdown file, so a new post is just a new file:

touch content/blog/my-new-post.md

If something here resonates with you, feel free to reach out.
